notes.title: Putt Down Demo Update 1.2.1
notes.notes: [p]Here's a small update for the Putt Down demo, including various QoL improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Power indicator when in putt mode[/p][/*][*][p]You can now skip the text at the beginning of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Random enemy spawn events will have an audio cue. Fixed events will still work like before.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tutorial video should be visible now[/p][/*][/list][p]Cheers[/p][p]Icehelm[/p]

notes.title: Putt Down Demo Update 1.2
notes.notes: [p]After some technical difficulties Putt Down Demo Update is finally hear.[/p][p]A lot of things have changed, fixed and added.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3715340/Putt_Down_Demo/" style="button"]Get the demo here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Xbox controller support[/p][/*][*][p]New story intro[/p][/*][*][p]New random events that trigger when stress is high enough[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stress will now change the text color on the status menu[/p][/*][*][p]Golf ball now has higher visibility, you will now see a trail when the ball moves. The ball material is also having some emissive properties to make it stand out more[/p][/*][*][p]More sounds for better feedback[/p][/*][*][p]More tutorial text[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Balance to trigger random events (Enemies should spawn less commonly now)[/p][/*][*][p]Balance to shotgun misfire (Should misfire a lot less now)[/p][/*][*][p]Fish now disappears after being shot[/p][/*][*][p]Head bob has been decreased by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient volume has been increased slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Some level tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]You no longer see the hidden shotgun when FoV is set to 110[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Cheers[/p][p]Icehelm[/p]
